contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP DIOCLETIANVS AVG ; R/ GENIO POPV LI ROMANI

Copper alloy coin. Silvered tetrarchic nummus of Diocletian (284-305), Trier mint issue of 303-305, RIC volume 6 no. 582a. Obverse description: Bullnecked bust laureate draped or cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP DIOCLETIANVS AVG. Reverse description: Genius standing left with mural crown holding patera and cornucopiae. S F in field. Reverse inscription: GENIO POPV LI ROMANI.
